repos_data.description: Open security scanner for AI supply chain and infrastructure: agents, MCP, containers, cloud, GPU, and runtime with blast-radius analysis.
CLI tool and library for generating a Software Bill of Materials from container images and filesystems

repo_meta_data.description: BomLens — a local-first SBOM generator & open-source risk assessor (CycloneDX). Produce an SBOM, an open-source notice, and a security/license risk report from source code, containers, binaries, firmware, or an SBOM you received. CLI or web UI, no SaaS.
